assumptions.text: IdealMac at each delivery: a tag verifies only if it was minted for exactly that claim, in every state.
assumptions.real_world: No real signature or MAC scheme with a total verifier meets it in every state (U478; Attack.TotalVerifierBreaksIdealMac; TotalReading.NoIdealMac).

assumptions.text: A2_MintOnlyOnCheck: every mint of one of our ids signs CheckedClaim(pre, t) for some pre, t with Authorizes(pre, t).
assumptions.real_world: The issuer (ts/refund-finality/minter.ts) signs only after the compiled RefundFinality.Check returns true. minter.ts is TESTED only.

assumptions.text: A5: the sink's sigOk boolean equals the model's VerifyTag on the delivered token at each delivery.
assumptions.real_world: sink.ts calls Ed25519 verify on exactly the bytes that the model calls the claim. Decomposed into H3a, H3b, H3c, B5.

assumptions.text: H1_SignatureAuthenticity (claim level, step-local): a delivered token whose tag verifies carries a claim signed earlier.
assumptions.real_world: Ed25519 EUF-CMA AND secrecy of the signing key; holds up to a negligible forgery probability, only while the key is secret.

assumptions.text: H1B_ByteUnforgeability: byte string and tag that verify were signed earlier (symbolic EUF-CMA at byte level).
assumptions.real_world: Same as H1, stated on bytes; with H3a/H3b/H3c/B5 it gives H1 and A5 (SliceTheoremV2.BytesGiveClaimAuthenticity).

assumptions.text: H3a: the claim serialization is injective.
assumptions.real_world: ts/refund-finality/encoding.ts is canonical and injective; not proved.

assumptions.text: H3b: at each delivery the sink rebuilds exactly Ser(ClaimOf(tok)) from the parsed token.
assumptions.real_world: sink.ts rebuilds the signed bytes; not proved.

assumptions.text: H3c: the model VerifyTag is the byte verifier applied to Ser(claim).
assumptions.real_world: A definition choice of the model; no real-world content beyond H3a and B5.

assumptions.text: B5: the crypto layer boolean is the byte verifier on the rebuilt bytes.
assumptions.real_world: Node OpenSSL Ed25519 verify returns the mathematical verifier value.
